title: DC-area forecast: A few showers overnight; staying humid until the weekend
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Mostly dry this evening with some scattered showers possible overnight. Evening temperatures fall out of the 80s with overnight lows in the upper 60s to mid-70s.

What’s next? Partly sunny tomorrow and Thursday, with moderately high humidity and widely scattered late day showers and storms. Friday is an iffy forecast before a more confidently cooler and less humid Saturday.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Partly to mostly cloudy with scattered showers and storms possible, mainly overnight. Lows toward dawn in the upper 60s to mid-70s with moderate mugginess. Light winds continue from the west at 5 to 10 mph. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Wednesday): Partly sunny, moderately muggy, and highs mainly in the mid- to upper 80s. Less moisture in the atmosphere should limit chances for showers and storms, but a couple could still pop up in the afternoon or evening. We may also still have a bit of smoky haze in our skies. Winds are light and variable in direction. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Partly to mostly cloudy with the chance of isolated to scattered showers and storms lingering into the evening. Still fairly muggy with lows in the upper 60s to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Thursday should begin the process of further lowering humidity as temperatures hit highs in the upper 80s to near 90 under partly sunny skies. There is still a chance for an isolated shower or storm though. Thursday night is partly cloudy with a few showers and storms possible and lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium-High

Friday has a chance to be dry with lower humidity, but that's only if a cold front slips far enough to our south, which models aren't so sure about. Some showers could break out. Highs should be in the 80s. After any showers exit in the evening, it dries out overnight with lower humidity. Lows settle in the 60s. Confidence: Low-Medium

The upcoming weekend looks to start nice on Saturday with mostly sunny skies, low humidity, and highs in the low to mid-80s. Sunday could trend a touch warmer and more humid with highs aiming for the mid- to upper 80s under partly sunny skies. A shower and storm chance could return late Sunday, but we'll have to see how things look as we get closer. Partly cloudy Saturday night with lows in the 60s again. Confidence: Medium

Next week looks like near-normal August weather with partly sunny days, highs mostly in the 80s, moderate humidity, and occasional thunderstorm chances.

Today’s daily digit — 5/10: We know some of you are tough graders, but hopefully you'll agree that today's slight drop in temperatures and humidity is a digit-boosting step in the right direction. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

DC weather history for August 11

Torrential rains in 1928 set a daily record and caused widespread flooding and rescues, while in 1984 another deluge produced extreme local totals—highlighting how dramatically rainfall can vary across short distances.
